Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator introduced flawed analysis logic and incorrect file handling in the first Python script: it (1) compared the XML CATEGORIES text directly to food names from the spreadsheet (misinterpreting the XML structure and the question, which requires identifying which category would contain the unique food), (2) ignored proper namespace handling, and (3) used incorrect/unstable file paths (referencing files outside the ZIP extraction).
